tools.description: Search captured archive material by content, path, or symbol; returns references and summaries. Capture and coverage may be partial or unavailable.

query.description: Free text, or prefixed selectors combined with spaces: path:<glob>, symbol:<name>, tool:<ToolName>.

tools.name: recall
tools.title: Recall

tools.description: Retrieve available archived content by hash or tool_use_id; fidelity and coverage may be incomplete. Returns the minimum sufficient span by default; pass full=true only when you need the whole available object. Ephemeral metadata describes Qompack records; host context retention is unknown.

full.description: Return the whole object instead of the minimum sufficient span.

hash.description: Root or chunk hash as sha256:<64 hex>. Provide exactly one of hash or tool_use_id.

span.description: Explicit span: "<off>:<len>" in bytes, or "L<start>-L<end>" in lines.

tool_use_id.description: tool_use_id taken from a tombstone or a recall hit.

tools.name: expand
tools.title: Expand

tools.description: Current or historical version of a file, from the store's own version history. Returns the minimum sufficient span by default; pass full=true only when you need the whole available object. Ephemeral metadata describes Qompack records; host context retention is unknown.

at.description: Empty for the working-tree version; otherwise an RFC3339 timestamp, sha256:<64 hex>, or turn:<N>.

full.description: Return the whole file instead of the minimum sufficient span.

path.description: Project-relative path. A :<symbol> or :<line> suffix anchors the minimal span.

tools.name: re_read
tools.title: Re-read

tools.description: Query recorded elimination evidence: legacy answers are absent, active, or stale; a failed query is unavailable. Clients must treat unavailable or unrecognized states as unknown, never as absence or a prohibition. Before committing to an approach, call already_tried.

approach.description: The approach as one short verb phrase — e.g. widen pool timeout.

tools.name: already_tried
tools.title: Already tried

tools.description: Write negative knowledge: record that an approach does not work, with evidence and the files the reason rests on, so it survives compaction.

depends_on.description: Project-relative paths whose contents this reason rests on; a change to any of them flips this record to stale.

reason.description: Why it does not work. Encode what a competent engineer with no session history would get wrong.

tools.name: record_eliminated
tools.title: Record eliminated

tools.description: Retrieve recorded session segments over a turn or timestamp range. Missing events and native context coverage may be unknown.

from.description: Turn index, RFC3339 timestamp, or empty for the session start.

to.description: Turn index, RFC3339 timestamp, or empty for the current frontier.

tools.name: timeline
tools.title: Timeline

tools.description: Retrieve an attributed decision and its evidence from the checkpoint chain. Recorded reasoning does not prove model compliance.

decision_id.description: A dec_<12 hex> id from a checkpoint or a rehydrated decision list.

tools.name: why
tools.title: Why

tools.description: Retrieve Qompack's recorded omissions for this session. This report does not establish what remains in native context.
tools.name: dropped
tools.title: Dropped
